title: Game Host Channel Descriptor
description: Schema for amitia-game-host/1 Channel Descriptor. Public protocol for third-party game plugin implementations.

id.description: Unique channel identifier within the plugin.

kind.description: Channel data type classification. Binary streaming is not part of amitia-game-host/1.

schemaId.description: Optional URI identifying the payload schema. Host does not interpret custom schema IDs.

direction.description: Protocol v1 channels are plugin-to-host only. Omit this field or use plugin_to_host; host-to-plugin delivery uses RPC.

frequencyHint.description: Hint for expected data frequency. Informational only, not enforced rate limiting.

metadata.description: Extension metadata. Core logic must not depend on undefined fields.
